Explanation:  
The question asks for the state of the losing team of the World Series three years before "Old Shufflefoot" (Lou Boudreau) won with his team. The year Boudreau led his team to victory was 1948, so we look at the 1945 World Series. The predicted answer states that Michigan (the Detroit Tigers) lost the 1945 World Series, but this is factually incorrect. In reality, the Detroit Tigers (from Michigan) won the 1945 World Series, and the losing team was the Chicago Cubs, whose home state is Illinois. The ground truth answer, Illinois, is therefore correct, while the predicted answer gives the wrong state.

Decision: FALSE
